items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: There was only one club that I know of and that was out where I was -- Les Hite was playing, that was the Cotton Club.

ctx.x: '32, what was happening out in California, jazz-wise, were there any clubs?
There was only one club that I know of and that was out where I was -- Les Hite was playing, that was the Cotton Club.
